combo_label: The Playground × The Allotment × Gilbert & Sullivan

entries.clue: Farmyard dung rotted down, barrowed in and dug through the beds
Louse eggs hunted with a fine-toothed comb after a note goes home
The mid-morning gap between lessons, a biscuit in hand
1887 opera whose ancestral portraits step out of their frames
Sovereign's ceremonial bodyguards, whose name begins an 1888 title ending 'of the Guard'
Game in which the catcher demands a peck on the cheek
Two-handed blades that clip the long grass round the edges
Communal upright fitting where the whole site draws its water
Its rays are all ablaze in the song of a Titipu bride-to-be
Frederic calls himself one of duty in the 1879 pirate subtitle
